title: Full-boundary recovery of both smooth isotropic elastic moduli
exact_target: For any bounded connected smooth domain in $R^3$, do identical static isotropic-elasticity traction Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps on $H^{1/2}(boundary;R^3)\to H^{-1/2}(boundary;R^3)$ imply equality of both smooth real Lamé functions lambda and mu throughout the domain, assuming $\mu >0$ and $3\lambda +2\mu >0$?
